description: This file defines the ProcessSnapshot class, representing a snapshot of a process with its threads, including methods for cloning, comparison, and thread retrieval based on various identifiers.

classes.name: ProcessSnapshot
classes.description: A class modeling a snapshot of a process, including its process ID, command line, date, and list of thread snapshots, with capabilities for comparison, cloning, and thread retrieval.

methods.name: ProcessSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor that creates an empty process snapshot.

methods.name: ProcessSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor that creates a deep copy of an existing ProcessSnapshot.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this ProcessSnapshot.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ProcessSnapshot with another based on process ID.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves a thread by its name.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves a thread by its thread ID (tid).

methods.name: getSysThread
methods.description: Retrieves a thread by its system thread ID (sysTid).
